remarks: Exceptional four-unit investment opportunity in one of Stamford's most convenient neighborhoods. This unique two-building package features two established and move in ready units in the front building and two brand new townhomes in the back all fully leased with tenants in place and generating $195,300 in annual gross income. The rear townhomes offer modern finishes, central air conditioning, all new appliances, and two dedicated garage parking spots. With 5,826 square feet of total living space across 12 bedrooms and 9 bathrooms, this property delivers exceptional scale and rental appeal. Investors will appreciate the low annual taxes of just $22,074 and a zoning designation of RMF, supporting long-term income stability. This is a true turnkey asset. Leases are in place, nothing needs to be done simply collect your return from day one with happy tenants in place.
